# Saphin Praja — Data Analyst

> Portfolio of Saphin Praja, a junior data analyst with fintech experience working in SQL, Python, and Power BI.

## Pages

- [Home](/): About, experience at Xuno, projects (FX Insights Automation, Reddit Competitor & Remittance Monitor, Saphin AI, Daily Reporting Automation), skills, and contact.

## Guides

- [Building Saphin AI: An AI Companion App](/guides/saphin-ai): Technical walkthrough of Saphin AI's architecture — the AI provider abstraction layer, Supabase JWT/JWKS auth, two-tier memory, hybrid proactivity, attachment handling, and the shared Expo/Expo Web codebase.
- [Building FX-Insight: Daily FX Market Data Automation](/guides/fx-insight): Technical walkthrough of the FX-Insight script — TradingView websocket candle fetching, session-close date handling, FII/DII scraping with fallbacks, openpyxl Excel writing, and Slack/Drive delivery.
